title: RentGuard Renters Policy — Refund, Write-Off and Collection Referral Thresholds
content:
Credit and collections standard for the RentGuard Renters Policy: the smallest credit balance refunded, the largest debit balance written off instead of billed once the policy has ended, and the number of calendar days after the cancellation date at which an unpaid earned-premium balance is referred to collections.

| Tier | Smallest credit balance refunded (USD) | Largest debit balance written off on an ended policy (USD) | Collection referral, calendar days after the cancellation date |
|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 1.00 | 5.00 | 45 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 1.00 | 5.00 | 45 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 1.00 | 10.00 | 45 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 1.00 | 10.00 | 45 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 1.00 | 15.00 | 60 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 1.00 | 25.00 | 60 |

## Observations on the thresholds

- The refund minimum of 1.00 is common to all six tiers.
- The write-off ceiling rises with the tier, from 5.00 on HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential to 25.00 on HO-4 Signature.
- The referral period is 45 calendar days on the four lower tiers and 60 on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
